eligibilityData.eligibilityBasisLabel: Consolidated sealing of more than one Nevada record held within this county under NRS 179.2595, where each underlying record is screened against the section that governs it — NRS 179.245 for a conviction, or NRS 179.255 where the proceedings did not result in a conviction — because consolidation changes the venue and not the eligibility
additionalFacts: Petitioner seeks to seal more than one record of criminal proceedings, and each record identified in this Petition is held within this county, including any record held by a justice court or a municipal court within the county.

Each record identified in this Petition appears on the verified criminal history from the Nevada Central Repository submitted with this Petition, which Petitioner obtained by fingerprint-based request to the Nevada Department of Public Safety, Records, Communications and Compliance Division.
Petitioner understands that a record held in any other Nevada county is not reached by this Petition and requires a separate petition in the district court of that county.
Petitioner states the reasons supporting sealing in the accompanying declaration; that statement is completed by Petitioner and is not supplied by any other person.
